data.name: Pradyumna
data.gender_notes: Pradyumna is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit pra, 'forth', + dyumna, 'splendour, might' — 'greatly mighty'. Its root is Sanskrit pra + dyumna. Pradyumna, son of Krishna. Pradyumna is a Sanskrit name meaning “Greatly mighty; Krishna's son”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pradyumna expresses “Greatly mighty; Krishna's son”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit pra, 'forth', + dyumna, 'splendour, might' — 'greatly mighty'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pradyumna total 41, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

vedic_reference.root_origin: Mahabharata, Son of Krishna and Rukmini
vedic_reference.note: Pradyumna is a revered and important character in Hindu mythology. He is the eldest son of Lord Krishna and Rukmini. Pradyumna is known for his strength, bravery, and wisdom. He is often depicted as an embodiment of grace and is revered by many Hindus.
